Bill numbers and descriptions for drafting

SIMULATED TEST MATERIAL - not an actual email, meeting record or contractual instruction. All senders, dates and proceedings are fictional. Case-backed values are checked against the supplied 2b documents. SIM14 contains separately labelled scenario-only drafting decisions, not 2b facts or real business approval.

Record ID: SIM04
Scenario date: 2024-12-12 (fictional)
Type: Simulated email
Fixture version: 20261006

From: Simulated QS <qs@consense-test.invalid>
To: Simulated Architect; Simulated Building Services Engineer
Subject: [SIMULATED] Bill numbers and descriptions for drafting

Dear all,

The bill schedule in SCT1 contains the following 13 bill numbers and descriptions. Please use this list for drafting; it is a bill identity list and does not imply that every bill is a measured BQ bill.

Bill No. | Exact description | Pricing type

1 | Preliminaries | BQ

2 | Preambles | BQ

3 | Substructure | BQ

4 | Superstructure for Podium | BQ

5 | Superstructure for Domestic Block | BQ

6 | Plumbing Works for Podium and Domestic Block | BQ

7 | Drainage | BQ

8 | External Works | BQ

9 | Electrical Works | SOR

10 | Fire Services and Water Pump Works | SOR

11 | Lift Works | SOR

12 | Site Safety; Environmental Management and Other Sundry Requirements (All Provisional) | BQ

13 | Provisional Sums | BQ

Bills 9 to 11 are schedules of rates. The issue of collection and summary pages separately does not create additional bill identities. Bill 12 includes the “All Provisional” qualification shown above.

Bill 12 is the parent Bill. Its safety, environmental management and site hygiene components include sub-numbers 12.2 to 12.4, which must be recorded as usage references rather than invented additional parent Bills. Their trade mapping and issue placement will be addressed in a later pricing reply.

Please keep the building services subcontract arrangement pending until the Building Services Engineer confirms the procurement model. The presence of the three services bills identifies work categories but is not, by itself, proof of NSC or BSSSC.

Regards,

Simulated QS

cases.originalSource:
Pricing Bill uses and photocopy rates reply

SIMULATED TEST MATERIAL - not an actual email, meeting record or contractual instruction. All senders, dates and proceedings are fictional. Case-backed values are checked against the supplied 2b documents. SIM14 contains separately labelled scenario-only drafting decisions, not 2b facts or real business approval.

Record ID: SIM10
Scenario date: 2024-12-20 (fictional)
Type: Simulated email
Fixture version: 20261006

From: Simulated QS <drafting@consense-test.invalid>
To: Simulated Project Team
Subject: [SIMULATED] Pricing Bill uses and photocopy rates reply

Dear project team, these are the additional case-backed answers for this simulated drafting exercise. Please retain their scope and source qualifications.

Contract pricing scheme

Contract pricing scheme: BQ_SOR

NTT includes Bills of Quantities plus SOR for BS Specialist Sub-contract Works, not a SOR-only contract.

HK$ per page up to A3

HK$ per page up to A3: 9.3

Case rate is HK$9.3 per page at or below A3; it is a case value rather than a present-day rate assertion.

Question about the photocopy charge for larger pages

What photocopy charge per page applies to document pages exceeding A3? The supplied communication does not give a project value. Leave this input unanswered for a person to determine.

Detailed SOR issue arrangement

For Bills 9, 10 and 11, detailed SOR excluding Master Collection Pages and Summary Pages are issued on Disc A only in the original tender documents. Original hard copies of those detailed SOR are issued in tender addendum or addenda. Electronic versions are reference copies. This is the specific SCT1(4)(d) arrangement; it is not a generic switch of all pages to Disc A or to hardcopy.

Safety environmental management and site hygiene

The shared exclusion refers to sub-numbers 12.2 to 12.4 of parent Bill 12. Electrical uses 12.2; Fire services and water pump uses 12.3. These two mappings are expressly quoted in the case SCC. Lift maps to the remaining 12.4 when the three-trade set is reconciled with the range; this last mapping is a documented inference, not an independent standalone quote.

Keep the thirteen formal parent Bill descriptions exactly as supplied in SIM04. Do not rename them with safety classifications, add a fourteenth parent Bill, or use Bill 12 for every specific trade sub-number. The parent list and sub-number usage links are separate records.

Bill 12 being labelled All Provisional, and Bill 13 being Provisional Sums, do not establish that all BQ quantities are provisional. The latter global question remains unanswered in the case-only checkpoint.

Document basis: 03 - NTT.docx - NTT1(a), (f); 10 - SCC.docx - SCC11.302(1); 05 - SCT.docx - SCT5(8)(b)

ConSense simulated drafting correspondence 20261006
